subject: Civil Engineering
title: Underpinning: Saving Existing Foundations
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Underpinning: Saving Existing Foundations.

hook.text: A new subway tunnel passes under an old building. The foundation needs deepening.

buildup.text: Underpinning extends an existing foundation deeper — section by section, carefully.

discovery.text: Mini-piles can be drilled through a basement floor to reach stronger soil below.

twist.text: Jet grouting injects cement slurry into the ground to create new support columns.

climax.text: London's Crossrail tunneled under hundreds of buildings — each one underpinned first.

punchline.text: You can fix what's under a building without tearing it down.

quiz.question: What is underpinning in geotechnical engineering?
options: Adding floors on top of an existing building
Extending or strengthening an existing foundation to go deeper
Painting the exterior of a building to protect against weather
